class.name: SpineBone
class.brief_description: A bone of a Spine skeleton, storing its current pose.
class.description: A bone of a Spine skeleton, storing its current pose. A bone has a local transform which is used to compute its world transform. A bone also has an applied transform, which is a local transform that can be applied to compute the world transform. The local transform and applied transform may differ if a constraint or application code modifies the world transform after it was computed from the local transform. The bone's world transform is relative to the skeleton's coordinate system origin. Use [method set_global_transform] and [method get_global_transform] to convert from and to Godot's Canvas coordinate system.

method.name: get_a
method.description: Part of the world transform matrix for the X axis. If changed, [code]update_applied_transform[/code] should be called.

method.name: get_a_scale_x
method.description: The local scaleX.

method.name: get_a_scale_y
method.description: The local scaleY.

method.name: get_a_shear_x
method.description: The local shearX.

method.name: get_a_shear_y
method.description: The local shearY.

method.name: get_a_x
method.description: The applied local x translation.

method.name: get_a_y
method.description: The applied local y translation.

method.name: get_applied_rotation
method.description: The applied local rotation in degrees, counter clockwise.

method.name: get_b
method.description: Part of the world transform matrix for the Y axis. If changed, [code]update_applied_transform()[/code] should be called.

method.name: get_c
method.description: Part of the world transform matrix for the X axis. If changed, [code]update_applied_transform()[/code] should be called.

method.name: get_children
method.description: The immediate children of this bone. Modifications of the array have no effect.

method.name: get_d
method.description: Part of the world transform matrix for the Y axis. If changed, [code]update_applied_transform()[/code] should be called.

method.name: get_data
method.description: The bone's setup pose data.

method.name: get_global_transform
method.description: Returns the bone transform as a [Transform2D] relative to Godot's global canvas coordinate space. Shear is not encoded in the transform.

method.name: get_parent
method.description: The parent bone, or null if this is the root bone.

method.name: get_rotation
method.description: The local rotation in degrees, counter clockwise.

method.name: get_scale_x
method.description: The local scaleX.

method.name: get_scale_y
method.description: The local scaleY.

method.name: get_shear_x
method.description: The local shearX.

method.name: get_shear_y
method.description: The local shearY.

method.name: get_transform
method.description: Returns the bone transform as a [Transform2D] relative to the [SpineSprite] node representing the skeleton. Shear is not encoded in the transform.

method.name: get_world_rotation_x
method.description: The world rotation for the X axis in degrees, calculated using a and c of the transform. The rotation is relative to the [SpineSprite].

method.name: get_world_rotation_y
method.description: The world rotation for the X axis in degrees, calculated using b and d of the transform. The rotation is relative to the [SpineSprite].

method.name: get_world_scale_x
method.description: The magnitude (always positive) of the world scale X, calculated using a and c. The scale is relative to the [SpineSprite].

method.name: get_world_scale_y
method.description: The magnitude (always positive) of the world scale X, calculated using b and d. The scale is relative to the [SpineSprite].

method.name: get_world_to_local_rotation_x
method.description: Transforms a world rotation to a local rotation. The world coordinate system is equal to the [SpineSprite] coordinate space.

method.name: get_world_to_local_rotation_y
method.description: Transforms a world rotation to a local rotation. The world coordinate system is equal to the [SpineSprite] coordinate space.

method.name: get_world_x
method.description: The world X position. If changed, [code]update_applied_transform()[/code] should be called. The world coordinate system is equal to the [SpineSprite] coordinate space.

method.name: get_world_y
method.description: The world Y position. If changed, [code]update_applied_transform()[/code] should be called. The world coordinate system is equal to the [SpineSprite] coordinate space.

method.name: get_x
method.description: The local x translation.

method.name: get_y
method.description: The local y translation.

method.name: is_active
method.description: Returns false when the bone has not been computed because [code]BoneData.get_skin_required()[/code] is true and the active skin does not contain this bone.

method.name: local_to_world
method.description: Transforms a point from the bone's local coordinates to world coordinates. The world coordinate space equals the coordinate space of the [SpineSprite].

method.name: local_to_world_rotation
method.description: Transforms a local rotation to a world rotation. The world coordinate space equals the coordinate space of the [SpineSprite].

method.name: rotate_world
method.description: Rotates the world transform the specified amount. After changes are made to the world transform, [code]update_applied_transform[/code] should be called and [code]update()[/code] will need to be called on any child bones, recursively.

method.name: set_global_transform
method.description: Sets the bone's transform to the global Godot [Transform2D].

method.name: set_to_setup_pose
method.description: Sets this bone's local transform to the setup pose.

method.name: set_transform
method.description: Sets the bone transform to the Godot [Transform2D].

method.name: update_world_transform
method.description: Computes the world transform using the parent bone and this bone's local transform.

method.name: world_to_local
method.description: Transforms a point from world coordinates to the bone's local coordinates. The world coordinate space is equal to the [SpineSprite] coordinate space.

method.name: world_to_local_rotation
method.description: Transforms a world rotation to a local rotation. The world coordinate space is equal to the [SpineSprite] coordinate space.
